response.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film WHERE rental_duration > 5 GROUP BY rating), b AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS bench FROM per WHERE avg_ratio IS NOT NULL) SELECT per.rating, per.avg_ratio, per.film_count, per.avg_ratio / b.bench AS ratio_to_benchmark FROM per CROSS JOIN b WHERE b.bench IS NOT NULL
